segments.en: [What is your name?] [Tzvi Yosef.] [Ah?] [Tzvi Yosef — Tzvi Yosef.] Freindt. (not understood) He gave me food to eat. (Saba shouts a strong "Oy.") (Saba laughs.) To me. (not understood) [He is a good young man. His father — he… went through the Shoah.] Ah? [His father is in Poland — in Poland.] From Poland? [He went through the Shoah there.] Yes — ah. [But he was in Russia.] In Russia. [He fled — he escaped to Russia.] Ah — ah. [And his mother also? Ten months — within ten months.] Nu. [Now he knows about Rebbe Nachman — ten months.] Nu. [He — he…] He was in the Shoah. [He did teshuvah.] Yes? [Yes.] Fortunate are we — fortunate are we. (Saba laughs.) [Fortunate are we. I told him — I told him that Rebbe Nachman was in Haifa.] Yes. [He is also from Haifa.] Yes — yes.
